about: Instafy ships no curated website restrictions. Provider-hosted retrieval follows the provider's access policies. A workspace may explicitly add site restrictions and optional guided links here for supported direct readers and browsers; private-network, authentication, consent and access-denial safeguards remain separate. An empty sites list applies no domain restrictions. Generic wrapper recognition and placeholder formats support explicit workspace policies; they never restrict a site by themselves. retiredDefaultSha256 identifies exact previously bundled defaults (SHA-256 of trimmed UTF-8 text), which readers ignore rather than treating as user policy. Edited policies are preserved.

wrappers.name: Google Translate's page proxy
wrappers.why: serves a site's pages at www-example-com.translate.goog

wrappers.name: archive.today
wrappers.why: serves copies at archive.ph/<time>/<address> and archive.ph/newest/<address>

wrappers.name: the Jina reader proxy
wrappers.why: serves a site's text at r.jina.ai/<address>

wrappers.name: 12ft.io
wrappers.why: serves a site's pages at 12ft.io/<address> and 12ft.io/proxy?q=<address>

wrappers.name: an open fetch proxy
